page.overview:
Who is Lady Jaye?

Lady Jaye was aboard the Flagg before it sank.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

Unlike Scarlett and Cover Girl, she had no lines during her appearances.

She also had no javelins, and two costume pieces similar to Flint.
